interview.secured: A day is secured when every task in all my challenges is done, which is what the screen said, and it bumped my streak to 1 day in a row.
interview.freeze: The app never explained a freeze to me in anything I saw, so I can't say what it is; the Monday circle with a dash might be related, but nothing told me.
interview.selfReported: It seems to mean I just said I did the task (like Read) and the app didn't verify it, though the screen only shows the label without explaining it.
interview.tomorrow: 7 - Setting up a challenge was quick and seeing the streak start at 1 is motivating, but I'm unsure about a few terms like freeze.

goals.text: Create a new challenge for friends from the Create tab with one simple check-off task. On the success screen copy the invite link. Then finish today's task with Done and choose Post to friends.

errors: create: Typed text did not appear in the field.
device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.
